description:
## Question

defk runs the C compiler on the build machine at compile time. The verdict's go/no-go rule (see "What must docs/verdict.md contain to count as done?") requires this stance to be settled: is a C toolchain at build time an acceptable requirement for a defk library (as for elixir_make packages), or does a library need a named way out (precompiled artefacts, a bundled compiler, a Cranelift JIT path, defk-o1w)? What does each option cost, and what goes in the verdict's Limitations?
title: Is a C compiler at build time acceptable for a defk library?
